item.title: Women’s Basketball: Fudd, Strong power No. 1 UConn past Villanova
item.description: Azzi Fudd helped lead a second-half comeback and finished with 25 points, and Sarah Strong scored 21 points despite early foul trouble as No. 1 UConn outlasted Villanova 83-69 on Wednesday night.

item.description: Por LAURA UNGAR La atención prenatal temprana mejora las probabilidades de tener un embarazo y un bebé sanos.
